title: failmodes
description: MCP server for the Fail Modes taxonomy — a knowledge base of AI system failure modes
summary: MCP server for the Fail Modes taxonomy — a knowledge base of AI system failure modes
offersHint: MCP server for the Fail Modes taxonomy — a knowledge base of AI system failure modes · Remote MCP (streamable-http) at https://www.failmodes.com/api/mcp · Packages: npm:failmodes-mcp

toolsPreview.name: search_failure_modes
toolsPreview.description: Search the Fail Modes taxonomy by symptom text or keyword phrase. Returns ranked matches with id, name, category, and matched context.

toolsPreview.name: get_failure_mode
toolsPreview.description: Retrieve the full structured record for a single failure mode by its ID slug (e.g. 'citation-hallucination', 'sycophancy').

toolsPreview.name: list_categories
toolsPreview.description: List all taxonomy categories with their IDs, names, descriptions, and mode counts.

toolsPreview.name: list_modes
toolsPreview.description: List failure modes, optionally filtered to a single category by category ID.
